positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered 160+ Jira tickets over 12 months — including 45 critical/highest-priority issues — across 15+ Go microservices powering Paramount’s converged content-distribution platform (playout, data-sync, transcode, notification, and content-safety services).
• Diagnosed and fixed a critical shared-library bug that silently dropped production MongoDB indexes on pod startup; redesigned index reconciliation from destructive desired-state to additive-by-default with opt-in destructive behavior, protecting every consuming service.
• Built a new backend notification service end-to-end: infrastructure and IAM, Jenkins CI/CD pipeline, 80%+ unit-test coverage, functional test suites for all reprocessing flows, operational runbooks, and service documentation.
• Created a centralized Kafka schema library (Protobuf) with automated Go/JS/Java code generation via Makefile targets, pre-commit hooks, and CI publish jobs — eliminating duplicated in-repo proto definitions across services.
• Rolled Kafka reliability improvements — dead-letter-queue wiring, retry and rate-limit handling, and consumer hardening — systematically across 7 microservices.
• Migrated services from direct Kafka / schema-registry integration to a centralized Event Mesh platform, then diagnosed and fixed post-migration gRPC load-balancing failures across environments.
• Resolved a P90 time-to-first-byte SLA violation (>250 ms) on the reverse proxy, restoring sub-250 ms latency across all endpoints.
• Owned 5 production releases (versioned service releases, Helm chart upgrades, CPU/memory resource tuning) and migrated 10+ repositories and shared libraries during a GitHub organization consolidation.
• Integrated distributed tracing through a shared observability library and implemented safety-critical content detection (flash-rate and extreme-loudness checks) in the classification pipeline with real-time Slack alerting.
